items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.author: alibaba
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴开源的 OpenCodeReview 是一个用 Go 编写的代码评审工具，采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构，能给出精确到行的评论，并内置覆盖 NPE、线程安全等问题的多语言规则集。官方称其已在阿里内部规模上经过验证，适合想把自动 code review 接入 CI、又不愿把判断完全交给大模型的团队。
items.summary_en: Alibaba has open-sourced OpenCodeReview, a Go code-review tool that combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to produce precise line-level comments, supported by a built-in multi-language ruleset covering issues such as NPEs and thread safety. It is described as battle-tested at Alibaba's scale, making it worth a look for teams wiring automated review into CI without trusting an LLM for every judgement.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 作者记录了自己从 Cursor 转向 OpenAI Codex 的经历：2025 年 4 月起自费订阅 Cursor，到 2026 年 4 月公司因 Cursor 改为按量计费、成本更高且不可预测，决定中国区改用 Codex。他最看重的是形态差异——Cursor 更像一个带 AI 的 IDE，Codex 更接近真正的超级 Agent。
items.summary_en: A developer recounts moving from Cursor to OpenAI Codex: after about a year on Cursor, starting with a $20/month personal plan in April 2025, his company switched its China region to Codex in April 2026, partly because Cursor moved from fixed licensing to usage-based billing that made costs higher and less predictable. His main takeaway is a difference in form: Cursor reads as an IDE with AI attached, while Codex feels closer to a general-purpose agent.

items.summary_en: Feishu (Lark) released version 8.0 on September 15 alongside native integration with Doubao Work, an enterprise agent that shares the same account system and can read work context within a user's permissions. Agents can now be pulled into group chats like members and handle docs, Base tables, calendars, meetings and approvals, while CLI-exposed capabilities grew from 247 in March to 767. Agents inherit the employee's access rights and admins can cap usage and restrict costly models; Doubao Work Partner is still limited to co-creation with select enterprises.

items.title: OpenAI 发布适用于编程和计算机应用的 GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，覆盖编程、计算机应用与网络安全，在 OSWorld 2.0 上得分 72.6%（GPT-5.6 Sol 为 65.7%），支持 100 万 token 上下文。它也是首个被 OpenAI 按 Preparedness Framework 归入"关键网络安全能力"级的模型，正逐步向 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 以及 API、Azure 和 AWS Bedrock 用户开放。
items.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, a model aimed at coding, computer use, professional workflows, and cybersecurity, scoring 72.6% on OSWorld 2.0 against 65.7% for GPT-5.6 Sol. It supports a 1M-token context, adds an experimental context mechanism in Codex, and is the first OpenAI model classified as having "critical cybersecurity capability"; it is rolling out to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise, plus API, Azure, and AWS Bedrock users.

items.title: OpenAI故意欠技术债，等Codex来还：仅2名工程师，把核心存储从Python重写成Rust
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 明知 Python 撑不住规模，仍把核心在线存储平台 Habitat 写成 Python 服务并主动欠下技术债，赌 Codex 能让日后重写变得便宜。今年第二季度，2 名工程师借助 Codex 和 GPT-5.5 将其重写为 Rust，新版本已承担 95% 生产请求，CPU 与内存效率分别提升 6 倍和 15 倍，延迟也明显下降。
items.summary_en: OpenAI deliberately took on technical debt by building Habitat, its core online storage platform, as a Python service, betting that Codex and GPT would eventually make a rewrite cheap. In the second quarter of this year, two engineers rewrote it in Rust with Codex and GPT-5.5; the Rust version now handles 95% of production requests with 6x better CPU efficiency, 15x better memory efficiency, and lower average and tail latency.

items.title: [分享创造] Tars: 把 iPhone 变成星际穿越里的 Mac agents 面板
items.summary_zh: Tars 是一个开源 iOS 应用，把 iPhone 变成《星际穿越》里 TARS 那样的纯黑面板，用眼睛睁合、转动等状态显示 coding agent 是空闲、干活、等你批准还是已完成。它做了低延迟通讯和 AMOLED 可变刷新率省电优化，还有多套主题，适合同时跑多个 agent、不想来回切窗口或盯终端的开发者，代码在 GitHub 的 reycn/tars。
items.summary_en: Tars is an open-source iOS app that turns an iPhone into a pure-black, Interstellar-style TARS panel for watching coding agents. Animated eyes show whether an agent is idle, working, waiting for approval, or finished, so you can check status out of the corner of your eye instead of switching windows or staring at a terminal. It uses low-latency communication and AMOLED variable-refresh-rate power optimizations, supports themes, and the code lives at reycn/tars on GitHub.

items.title: Agent开始调用基础设施，Kubernetes准备好了吗？
items.summary_zh: 在 KubeCon China 2026 上，InfoQ 与 OpenInfra 基金会总经理 Thierry Carrez、CNCF 执行总监 Jonathan Bryce 讨论了 AI Agent 对云基础设施的冲击：Kubernetes 已通过 DRA（动态资源分配）让 GPU 等加速器更灵活接入集群，CNCF 也推出 Kubernetes AI Conformance 统一兼容规则。文章追问的是，当决定申请资源、调用工具的主体从人变成 Agent，为人设计的云原生控制面还能不能继续用。
items.summary_en: At KubeCon China 2026, InfoQ spoke with OpenInfra general manager Thierry Carrez and CNCF executive director Jonathan Bryce about how AI agents are shaking up cloud infrastructure assumptions. Kubernetes is using DRA (Dynamic Resource Allocation) to plug GPUs and accelerators into clusters more flexibly, while CNCF launched Kubernetes AI Conformance to agree on compatibility rules. The open question: once agents decide when to request resources and call tools, can control planes designed for humans still work?

items.summary_en: Cloudflare has moved cdnjs, which serves roughly 9 billion requests a day, off its mixed Cloudflare and Google Cloud publishing stack and onto its own developer platform, making R2 the authoritative source for published files while Workers, Workflows and KV handle package ingestion. items.summary_en: In a Lawfare essay, Bruce Schneier and Cindy Cohn trace how post-9/11 US surveillance shifted from targeted wiretaps and pen register orders to mass collection of internet backbone traffic and phone or internet metadata. They argue that legal and technical architecture has long outgrown its counterterrorism framing, noting ICE now applies it in immigration enforcement and against protesters, while private systems such as Madison Square Garden facial recognition and Flock license plate readers push it further into daily life.

items.summary_en: The post looks at Qwen3.8-27B, a local model that brings flagship-level agent capability to a personal machine without paying API fees. The author is upfront about the trade-offs: inference speed, memory footprint and long-task experience remain real barriers. It suits developers willing to run local inference who can live with slower responses.

items.summary_zh: 文章用 Three.js 实现了一个简易版电影《牛来》的效果，并附上完整代码和演示效果。作者提到这部据传仅两人主创的电影因“土到极致就是潮”而走红；适合想借热点练习 Three.js 动画的开发者。
items.summary_en: This post builds a simplified Three.js version of the viral Chinese movie Niu Lai, with the full source code and a demo. The author notes the film is reportedly created by just two people and became popular for its proudly cheesy aesthetics. It's a good starting point for developers learning Three.js through a trending cultural reference.

Developers tracking how agent engineering is maturing get a quick scan of what the community is actually building.

items.summary_zh: 前端开发者“小张同学”结合近期每天用 AI 写代码的体验，分享了一套 AI 全栈开发实践，并坦言手写代码能力已经明显下降。他认为按当前节奏，AI 编写代码会在更多场景替代人工。适合正在搭建 AI 辅助编程流程的开发者参考，也提醒自己别丢掉基本功。

The post is useful for developers building AI-assisted workflows and doubles as a warning about foundational-skills atrophy.
